caption: ⚖️ Lesson of the day: Risk-reward ratio. It compares how much you risk on a trade with how much you aim to gain. Example only: risking 10 dollars to aim for 20 dollars is a ratio of 1 to 2. With that ratio, you can lose about half of your trades and still stay near break-even. A low ratio forces you to win very often, which is hard to keep up. Check the ratio before you enter, and skip setups that do not offer enough room. Educational content, not financial advice. Trading is high risk.
